item.title: We have a group of ageing farmers; we need young ones – KZN MEC
item.description: The KwaZulu-Natal MEC for Agriculture and Rural Development, Thembeni kaMadlopha-Mthethwa, has called on young South Africans to consider agriculture as their career of choice, citing the urgent need to rejuvenate the sector’s ageing workforce.

item.title: AMT Fresh Produce Outlook | Tomatoes drop 40%
item.description: If you’re farming fresh produce right now, this is not the week to ignore the markets.

item.title: FMD disaster declaration must translate into action – Free State Agriculture
item.description: The declaration of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) as a national disaster by President Cyril Ramaphosa during the State of the Nation Address has been described by Free State Agriculture (FSA) as a pivotal moment for South Africa’s livestock sector.

item.title: TUT Professor Puffy Soundy appointed Chair of AgriSETA
item.description: In a move that signals renewed focus on agricultural education and skills development, Professor Puffy Soundy from Tshwane University of Technology (TUT) has been appointed as Chairperson of the Agricultural Sector Education and Training Authority (AgriSETA) Board.

item.title: FMD | Disaster status allows changes to legislation
item.description: The recent classification of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) as a national disaster makes the availability of additional resources and capacity possible, and legislation can be amended during the disaster period to manage the crisis.

item.title: Private vet leads FMD awareness drive in Madibeng
item.description: With foot-and-mouth disease (FMD)continuing to place livestock farmers on high alert in North West, a private veterinary practice in Brits has taken proactive steps to curb the further spread of the disease through a focused awareness campaign.

item.title: FMD | First private vet authorised to help with vaccinations
item.description: A private veterinarian from the Mossel Bay district is the first in the country to be authorised to assist a state veterinarian with the vaccination of animals against foot-and-mouth disease (FMD). A further 100 applications from private veterinarians have already been submitted.

item.title: Peanut butter recalled over aflatoxin
item.description: Certain ButtaNutt peanut butter products have been recalled at the manufacturer’s request after aflatoxin levels exceeded the legal limit.
